label: late original phase / <DEL> when the sequence starts with a or q
explanation: Fires from step 3 of the original phase through the <DEL> step (recall_idx<=0) in sequences whose first original token is a or q. It also fires, more weakly, when a/q is the second token (from step 4 on). The rest of the original token content barely matters. It is silent at t=0..2 and almost silent in the copy phase, apart from a weak tail at the first copy outputs (e.g. recall_idx 1 after a leading a). Magnitude is largest for first_tok=a, especially with repeated a at the start (aaa..., top examples ~1.0). It peaks at the middle-to-late original steps and at <DEL>, and is smaller for q and for a/q in position 1. y and o as the first token give weaker activations (lift ~2x), which the predicate leaves out. Low-quartile activations are spread diffusely over other sequences and are not captured. Dev F1 0.745, mass recall 0.84.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: a, q, y, o, 0, d; least: 3, 2, z, h) and the second original token (most: a, q, y, o, p, k; least: x, 3, 2, z); timing cues that raise it most: t=5, t=4, t=6.
